message:
Let me continue looking at the rest of packet_parse and the RTCM3 handling. The RTCM3_RECOGNIZED case looks interesting - it reads `lexer->inbuffer[idx + 1]` and `lexer->inbuffer[idx + 2]` which could be out of bounds if `idx` is near the end of the buffer. But the issue is "Use-of-uninitialized-value". Let me look at the RTCM3 states in nextstate and the rest of packet_parse.

<｜｜DSML｜｜
<parameter=command>sed -n '2800,3170p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpsd/gpsd/packet.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
